legend: An undirected graph is cylindrical if it can be split it into two disjoint simple cycles of equal length such that the ith node in the first cycle is connected to the ith node in the second cycle.

Given an undirected graph of even number of nodes n and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c063f76865b7aa79a2b40d593bc1237da1c85dae.png) edges, determine whether it is cylindrical or not, and if it is, print the two cycles that forms it (check the output section for the exact requirements).
input: The first line of input contains an even integer n (6 ≤ n ≤ 105), the number of nodes in the graph.

Each of the following ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c063f76865b7aa79a2b40d593bc1237da1c85dae.png) lines contains two integers u and v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n, u ≠ v), representing an edge connecting the nodes u and v. Each pair of nodes is connected by at most one edge.
output: Print "NO" if the given graph is not cylindrical. Otherwise, print "YES" followed by two lines, each containing the nodes of one cycle in following format:
- Each consecutive nodes in a cycle must be connected by an edge in the input. Also the first and the last nodes in the cycle must be connected.
- The ith node in the first cycle must be connected to the ith node in the second cycle.
- Each of the n nodes must belong to exactly one of the cycles.
If there is more than one solution, you can print any of them.

legend: 无向图是圆柱形的，如果它可以被分割成两个长度相等的不相交简单循环，使得第一个循环中的第一个节点与第二个循环中的第一个节点相连。

Given an undirected graph of even number of nodes n and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c063f76865b7aa79a2b40d593bc1237da1c85dae.png) edges, determine whether it is cylindrical or not, and if it is, print the two cycles that forms it (check the output section for the exact requirements).
input: 输入的第一行包含一个偶数n(6≤n≤105)，即图中的节点数。

Each of the following ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c063f76865b7aa79a2b40d593bc1237da1c85dae.png) lines contains two integers u and v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n, u ≠ v), representing an edge connecting the nodes u and v. Each pair of nodes is connected by at most one edge.
output: 如果给定的图不是圆柱形的，则打印 “NO”。否则，打印 “YES”，后面跟两行，每行包含一个循环的节点，格式如下：
—在一个循环中，每个连续的节点必须通过输入中的一条边连接。循环中的第一个节点和最后一个节点也必须连接起来。
第一个循环中的第一个节点必须连接到第二个循环中的第一个节点。
- n 个节点中的每个节点都必须恰好属于其中一个循环。
如果有多个解决方案，则可以打印其中的任何一个。
